description: Core: what Rhea is with nothing installed — the ledger's vocabulary (company, account, posting, the period's lock, exchange rates), the invoice's common shape and its tax rate, contractors, Rachunki i karty's bank accounts, bank lines and settlements, and tasks. Market-neutral; the kernel carries it in its binary and rhea init drafts what a database lacks.
disclaimer: This pack was prepared by artificial intelligence (AI). It is an initial version: its definitions may contain errors and will change as accountants, tax advisers and auditors review them.

history.changes: Every App says where it sits and which faces show it (KK, 2026-10-30: "all our SmartApps should have their location path and whether they are visible on desktop and on mobile"): each App names its activity and, where it has one, its section — Today for the day's Apps, Sales for the invoices and clients, Costs for the purchases and suppliers, Bank, Books for the journal, the trial balance, the chart, the rates and the firms, Settings for the platform's own — and shows on the desk and the phone. No other definition changes.

A client or a supplier added by hand, before any invoice (KK, 2026-10-30: "we need to be able to add companies by NIP"): Klienci's New client and Dostawcy's New supplier take a firm, the day it is ours from and any of its terms; its first invoice later finds it and adds no other; added again, the firm stays one client or supplier and the terms given update it.

The group trial balance in EUR for a period too (KK, 2026-10-27): the same columns as a company's — each account's balance when the financial year opened, the period's turnover, the turnover since the year opened, the balance at the period's end — every company's lines translated at the EUR rate of the period's last day (the latest published on or before it), the translation difference balancing each pair of columns. Each row names its accounts. It summed every line since the books began at the latest rate there was.

The trial balance is the one the law describes (UoR art. 18 ust. 1), for the period a person picks: each account's balance when the financial year opened, the period's turnover, the turnover since the year opened and the balance at the period's end, each on its side; asked for no period, it is the first month the books have not closed; the financial year is the one the company's own record says (financial_year_start, which a market's company carries), else the calendar year. Each row names its account, so a face opens the account's ledger from it. It summed every entry since the books began.

Clients and suppliers as roles of one firm (KK, option A): the client and supplier records, each pointing at the firm and holding its own terms. A firm's first sales invoice makes it a client, its first purchase invoice a supplier, each from the invoice's date; the terms are set through set_client_terms (payment terms, discount, credit limit, price list, account manager) and set_supplier_terms (payment terms, whether its invoices need approval). The lists Clients and Suppliers.

The platform's own screens as Apps (step 5 of the Apps): Today, the day's decisions and her words; My company, the company's own page; Desk and look, the desk's settings. Each is a screen the desk draws, now an App a market's words can place on the Activity Bar like any other. No other definition changes.

Written as Apps: each kind of record, screen, door and rule of the core is in one App — Invoices, Companies, Chart of accounts, Journal, Trial balance, Period close, VAT rates, FX rates, Sales invoices, Purchase invoices, Bank accounts and cards, Tasks, Packs. No definition changes; what is approved is the Apps themselves.

Installing a pack in a company: the installed_pack record (which pack, from which day, until which day, who installed it and who switched it off), the doors install_pack and switch_off_pack, and the rules that keep each install and switch-off as the company's record — the kernel checks every install against the catalog before it is a fact.

The core as a pack the kernel ships: the founding vocabulary at its latest versions (company, invoice, account, posting, period_lock, vat_rate, sales_invoice, fx_rate, purchase_invoice and their views), and the contractor, Rachunki i karty's types and the task list as the Poland pack v44 carries them — nothing changes where they already are.

citations: every ledger keeps accounts, journal entries and periods; every company keeps bank accounts, bank statements and the settlement of its documents against them
DIRECTION 2026-10-23, Core, market packs and business packs: what Rhea is with nothing installed
